rows.explainer:
GiveWell-funded work by Malaria Consortium made up roughly 50% of total SMC funding in Burkina Faso in 2021, targeting 2 million children out of a total target population of 4.2 million. See https://files.givewell.org/files/DWDA%202009/Malaria%20Consortium/Malaria_Consortium_seasonal_malaria_chemoprevention_program_Philanthropy_report_2021.pdf, page 18. 

This implies that there would be significant scope to prioritize some areas over others in the absence of GiveWell-directed funding. There appears to be moderate variation in malaria rates across Burkina Faso: https://malariaatlas.org/explorer/#/

rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
